cron.description: 6-field Quartz cron of the TTL sweep (ACCESS_SWEEP_CRON). Cron runs in UTC.

description.purpose: The tick of the TTL sweep. It sends, it decides nothing.
description.use_when: Inside the access hive; change the cadence at runtime with add/modify/remove ops by schedule_id.
description.not_in_scope: No catch-up, and none needed: a missed firing costs nothing because the expiry that matters is the comparison ./invoke makes on every call, and the next tick sweeps the same rows.
description.emits_meaning: A plain trigger. The lane's state starts empty, which is how ./sweep recognises the start of a tick.
description.consumes_meaning: Schedule ops (add/modify/remove by schedule_id) as body.op.
examples: every five minutes -> ./sweep; nothing expired -> one select and silence
